Summary:

Discover your dream holiday home in 30A! Located steps from the beach, this house offers a perfect blend of luxury and convenience. With its elegant design, spacious bedrooms (each with a private bathroom), and a refreshing outdoor pool, White Haven is ideal for large groups. Explore nearby attractions like Rosemary Square and Pier Park, and experience the best of the Emerald Coast.



The Space:

☆☆ HIGHLIGHTS ☆☆



✹ 6 spacious bedrooms w/ ensuite bathrooms; 4 kings, 3 twins, 2 fulls + full-size sofa bed

✹ 6 full baths w/ a mixture of walk-in showers + soaking tubs

✹ Full kitchen w/ modern appliances

✹ Breakfast bar w/ 4 stools

✹ Stylish dining area w/ seating for 6-8

✹ Kitchenette w/ large mini-fridge + wet bar

✹ Open-concept living area w/ large TV

✹ Bonus living room w/ large TV + comfy seating

✹ Loft area w/ dedicated workspace

✹ High-speed wifi throughout

✹ Bluetooth surround sound

✹ In-unit laundry room w/ full-size washer + dryer

✹ Large balcony w/ bistro-style table, relaxing chairs + propane BBQ grill

✹ Covered patio w/ outdoor seating

✹ Private outdoor shower

✹ Direct access to an outdoor pool, shared between just 8 homes

✹ Free parking on-site

✹ 4 adult bikes provided

✹ A 30A retreat in Inlet Beach, part of the private gated resort community of Pinecrest

✹ Amazing location, short walk from the beach, local restaurants + shops

✹ Short drive to Panama City Beach + beyond



Eager to Read More?



Here Are A Few Kind Words From Our Previous Guests:



“Beautiful and spacious house for our large group! The space was just as the pictures showed. The walk to the beach was ~5min and easy. The house sits directly outside of Rosemary beach, so walking and biking into town was very convenient as well. We did have to reach out to the host/mgmt company as some codes provided in the initial instructions did not work, but they were quick to respond and provide new ones! Definitely recommend for a large group.” –Casey



“Lovely stay ! Mins away from Rosemary beach - they actually share borders with it. Easy check in ! Will def come back” –Smriti



“We had a terrific stay at this Unwind property. It’s super close to Rosemary beach, so we were able to walk to restaurants, shopping, etc. The communication from Unwind was great. We knew exactly what to expect and didn’t have any surprises. Our group had an excellent time and would recommend this house to anyone coming to Inlet beach. It was super helpful to be able to rent for 4 nights instead of the required 7 nights at most places. They also worked with us and allowed us to access the property 2 hours early at check in since no one had rented the property the day before. Overall, a fabulous trip!! Thanks Unwind!” –Jacqueline



★★ BEDROOMS ★★

Each of the six charming bedrooms offers a peaceful, impeccably furnished haven to relax in during your vacation. With comfortable beds, premium sheets, TVs, and ensuite bathrooms for your convenience, you’re sure to find your zen during this getaway.



✹ Primary Bedroom (first floor): King-sized bed, chair + ensuite bathroom

✹ Bedroom 2 (first floor): King-sized bed, chair, + ensuite bathroom

✹ Bedroom 3 (first floor): 2 twin beds + private bathroom

✹ Bedroom 4 (second floor): King-sized bed + ensuite bathroom

✹ Bedroom 5 (second floor): King-sized bed + full bathroom

✹ Bedroom 6 (third floor): Full-over-full bunk bed, pullout twin trundle + private bathroom



✔ Flat-screen TV in each bedroom

✔ Additional full-sized hide-a-bed sofa in the bonus living room



★★ BATHROOMS ★★

You’ll never have to wait in line when you stay at beautiful White Haven, as every bedroom has a dedicated full bath. With a choice of large walk-in showers or a relaxing soaking tub, you can freshen up exactly the way you like. Modern, sparkling clean, and relaxing, you’ll find each bathroom an oasis of calm.



✹ Bathroom 1: Ensuite to primary bedroom w/ a generously-sized shower

✹ Bathroom 2: Full bath to bedroom 2 w/ a separate soaking tub + stand-up shower

✹ Bathroom 3: Private bathroom to bedroom 3 w/ large shower

✹ Bathroom 4: Full bathroom to bedroom 4 w/ a huge walk-in shower + dual vanity

✹ Bathroom 5: Full bath to bedroom 5 w/ shower + access via living room

✹ Bathroom 6: Private bath to bedroom 6 w/ roomy shower



✔ Fresh towels

✔ Laundry room w/ full-size washer + dryer



★★ KITCHEN & DINING ★★

The well-appointed kitchen is fitted with state-of-the-art stainless steel appliances for an easy, breezy cooking experience. The open-floor design lends a sense of space and freedom, while the wide countertops provide ample room for even the messiest chefs to prepare delicious meals.



The lovely breakfast bar is ideal for pulling up a stool to keep the chef company or simply enjoying that first sip of morning coffee. When it’s time to eat, you’ll find the farmhouse-style dining table the perfect spot for entertaining and relaxing.



A small kitchenette can be found on the lower floor, tucked away next to the bonus living room. It’s a convenient spot for shaking up a cocktail or fixing some snacks for a family movie night or an outdoor meal.



✔ Modern kitchen w/ high-end appliances (including dishwasher + gas stove)

✔ Basic cookware + dinnerware

✔ Coffee maker

✔ Breakfast bar w/ seating for 4

✔ Large dining table w/ seating for 6-8

✔ Kitchenette w/ mini-fridge, wet bar, standalone ice maker + pool-friendly plasticware



★★ LIVING ROOM ★★

After taking a short, scenic drive to breathtaking Panama City Beach, there’s nothing better than coming home to relax in the luxurious, yet cozy, living room. Sit back on the plump sectional, feel the warmth of the natural light streaming in through the wraparound windows, and enjoy the airy ambiance provided by the high ceilings.



Venture downstairs to discover the bonus living room, where you’ll find plenty of comfortable seating options and a large TV. Make some popcorn and settle down to enjoy your favorite movie or an evening of traditional board games.



Climb the contemporary spiral staircase and you’ll find yourself in the spacious loft area. Kitted out with a desk and chair, it’s a lovely spot for remote working without being too far away from the fun!



✔ Large flat-screen TV

✔ Pristine white sectional + comfy chairs

✔ High ceilings + an abundance of natural light

✔ Direct access to the outside deck

✔ Family-friendly board games

✔ Bonus living room w/ large TV + more seating options

✔ Office space w/ desk, chair + printer



★★ OUTDOOR SPACE ★★

There’s only one way to enjoy the Emerald Coast and that’s outdoors! Hop on one of the bikes provided and explore the local area. It’s a 2-minute bike ride down 30A to Rosemary main square and Seacrest main square. When you want to visit the beautiful beach, you’ll have easy access to the white sands via the neighborhood boardwalk.



Of course, there’s plenty of fun and relaxation to be had at home. Chill out on the private balcony or shaded outdoor seating area with a cup of coffee or cold beverage. Enjoy a tasty BBQ and a dip in the community pool, which is shared with only 8 other houses in the gated neighborhood.



✔ Large balcony w/ chairs + bistro-style table

✔ Shaded patio w/ outdoor living room furniture

✔ Propane BBQ grill

✔ Outdoor shower

✔ Access to shared outdoor pool w/ sun loungers

✔ 4 adult bikes



★★ ACTIVITIES/ATTRACTIONS ★★

The white sands of the enchanting Emerald Coast are not to be missed, and our charming home is just steps away from the least crowded spots. The best local shops and restaurants can be enjoyed over at Rosemary Beach, 30 Avenue, or Seacrest, plus the highway is easily accessible making it easy for you to hit the road and go exploring. Check out more of the exciting options available when you stay at “White Haven”:



✔ Rosemary Beach: This charming coastal town is known for its beautiful architecture, quaint streets, and stunning beaches. It’s the perfect spot to enjoy a day at the beach, take a stroll, or sample some local cuisine.

✔ Gulf World: Take a short drive over to Panama City Beach, which is home to a plethora of attractions, including Gulf World. This marine park is home to many species of wildlife, and the park offers interactive experiences with its residents. Enjoy live shows, participate in educational activities, or even take a dip with the dolphins!

✔ Shell Island: Located just off the coast of Panama City Beach is Shell Island, a hidden gem known for its natural beauty and abundance of seashells. Take a boat tour or rent a pontoon boat, then spend the day snorkeling, sunbathing, and of course, collecting seashells!



All these activities and more are within your reach when you book with us!



★☆ Book Today & Let Us Take Care Of You In Emerald Coast! ☆★



Guest Access:

✹ GENERAL: Your whole group will enjoy private access to the entire home as well as the neighborhood pool, shared with just 8 other homes.



✹ PARKING: Free parking is available in the large driveway.



✹ WORK FROM HOME: There is free, high-speed wifi available throughout the home, plus a designated workspace on the top floor.



✹ PETS: We have a no-pet policy.



✹ COMMUNITY ACCESS: You will have free access to the community pool. The Rosemary Beach Racquet Club is across the street, where you can enjoy a game of tennis with daily/weekly pass options available.



Don’t hesitate to reach out with any questions - we look forward to hosting you!



Other Things to Note:

✹ Easy self-check-in is available via the keypad on the front door.



✹ Four adult bikes are provided for you to enjoy exploring the local area. Please take care to lock the bikes wherever you go. If any are missing post-stay, you will be held responsible.



✹ No smoking is permitted.



✹ The home is professionally cleaned between each booking.



✹ The home is conveniently located immediately next door to the Rosemary Beach East boundary, and the first left of HWY98, helping you to avoid traffic.
Our prices include all fees. No hidden fees.
